question:
Directions: Each of the following questions has underlined idioms/phrases. Each sentence is followed by four options. Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase.

In the long run
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e**. 'In the end'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"In the long run"** refers to the ultimate outcome or result after a prolonged period. 

 
 
• In English, it implies **"over a long period of time"** or "eventually" (लंबे समय के बाद).
 
 
 
• **Example:** Even though studying can be exhausting, in the long run, your efforts will pay off.
 
• The term **"In the end"** signifies the final result or consequence of an action or a series of actions (अंत में).
 
 
• **Example: **In the end, they succeeded because they didn't give up and kept working hard.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is - '**In the end'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Purposeful refusing'** (Option 1) indicates the act of intentionally denying or rejecting something (सामयिक इनकार).
 
• **'Simultaneously' **(Option 2) refers to events happening at the same time (एक साथ).
 
• **'Careful running' **(Option 4) can refer to running with caution, although it doesn't correspond to a known idiom or phrase (सतर्क दौड़).
